Things to Know

A deal meets a toggle (15+ paid impressions, 3+ paid clicks, or 3+ paid engagements) when its 12-month journey sum clears the bar.
  • Toggle. A deal meets a toggle (15+ paid impressions, 3+ paid clicks, or 3+ paid engagements) when its 12-month journey sum clears the bar; if that window is incomplete or missing, we use the higher of the journey floor and the Nov 5 snapshot total.
  • Campaign shares. A deal can be credited to several campaigns, so campaign shares can add to more than 100%.
  • Journey months. Monthly journey counts are calendar months through the create month, not a day-level 365-day or pre-create window. A missing month is not zero.
  • Possible job titles. Estimated by weighting each campaign’s LinkedIn title impression shares by that company’s Fibbler campaign impressions. Title reports cover December 2024 through Nov 15, 2026, using only complete months before each opportunity’s create month. Company campaign totals are snapshot weights and may include later activity. Coverage is the share of company campaign impressions with matching title data. Rankings describe possible roles, with approximate and suppressed LinkedIn demographic counts. Influencer, content creator and exact Member titles are excluded. Rankings stay tied to the opportunity when the report’s period filter changes. LinkedIn job titles as of Nov 15, 2026. Deals are per Fibbler.
  • Influence. A deal counts when paid LinkedIn activity before the deal reaches the selected threshold: 3+ paid clicks, 3+ paid engagements, or 15+ paid impressions. Every deal number on the page uses the same filters.
  • Business type. New business and Existing business are the deal type. A missing, blank, or "-" deal type counts as Existing business. A deal name containing "upsell" or "expansion" (any case) counts as Existing business even when the type says New business. A hyphen in a company name is not a missing type. All includes both types, and each deal is listed once.
  • Create vs close. Pipeline, the deal table, campaign-by-deal cards, and journeys use the create date. Influenced revenue uses the close date (Closed Won only). A deal created last year and won this year counts as revenue in the period it closed.
  • Pipeline. Pipeline created includes every filtered deal created in the period, any stage. Open pipeline is deals that are not Closed Won or Closed Lost.
  • Cost per opp created. Each filtered opportunity created in the period is counted as a demo proxy, including deals with no amount. That equivalence is an assumption, not a verified demo event. The figure is DPP spend for the three product promotion groups divided by that count. It is not paid causal attribution. n/a means no opportunities were created in the view.
  • Currency. Ad spend is DPP spend in EUR for the three product promotion groups and is not converted. Deal amounts are stored in USD and shown in EUR.
  • Time frames. YTD is Jan 1 to Nov 15, 2026. L3M is Aug 1 to Oct 31, 2026. LFM is October 2026. MTD is Nov 1 to Nov 15, 2026. November covers 15 of 30 days. LinkedIn spend and job titles are as of Nov 15, 2026. Deals are per Fibbler.
  • Coverage. LinkedIn spend and job titles are as of Nov 15, 2026. Deals are per Fibbler: the Nov 5 snapshot plus 2 deals found on Nov 15, 520 deals in total, for Fibbler Modash (cm3vweh7q008h8qqtv3e112i1) and LinkedIn ads account 510440948. Spend uses the three Direct Product Promotion groups only (group IDs 691266574, 1011122604, and 1109801364; 44 campaigns). Their rows sum to €111,846 for Jan 1 through Nov 15. Deal rows still include other campaigns. 79 deals have no campaign split.
  • Ad type mix. Spotlight ads are excluded. The account ran image and video ads in 2026.
